 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 13 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) A major time unfolding for you, Cancer . You have planned out certain parts of your life; you have envisioned certain goals, and now you may feel trapped in fear of actually putting them into action. This loop and fear of failure needs to come to a close. The path that has been calling out to you and been feeling so enticing has a purpose to serve—and for this, you need to let go of your idea of certainty and comfort that you have gotten so used to. A new, more enhanced vision and future are calling you, but you must be willing to take that step towards this calling first.
 Cosmic tip: Re-evaluate and reassess your path ahead honestly and then gently release your grip over your familiar past.
